caption: The drawing depicts a cylindrical container with a lid, decorated with a colorful outdoor scene. The main motif on the side of the container shows a white deer with visible antlers, standing or leaping in a landscape that contains several green trees with brown trunks and branches, as well as green shrubs and foliage at the base. The background behind the deer is mostly blue, suggesting a sky or open space. The lid of the container displays a less detailed greenish pattern with some brown and blue areas, and there is a decorative blue and white band along the upper edge of the container, just below the lid. The entire composition is rendered with visible brushwork and lines, giving definition to the natural forms. The drawing itself is centered on a plain, beige background, and the artist’s signature “J. Rothenberg” appears in the lower left corner.
title: Bandbox
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
